Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:03:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: streaming latency & concurrency — decision logistics

Thanks again Jorge and Amy for taking the time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track decisions.

Key items we covered (demo highlights):
- Streaming p95 latency target you mentioned: <= 120ms for short completion updates (<= 256 tokens).
- Sustained throughput target: ~750–900 tokens/sec for peak windows (primarily during catalog refreshes).
- Concurrent active sessions target: 35–45 (predictable spikes at 4–6AM PT).
- Fallback behavior: if latency spikes, app will accept partial responses; we discussed graceful degradation to smaller model variant.

Open questions for you to confirm (see attached MAP template where we captured these):
1) Do you need strict p99 SLAs or is p95 sufficient to drive the GA acceptance?
2) What are the top 3 endpoints that require streaming vs batch gen?
3) Do you have existing token-rate measurements from your client-side telemetry for peak hours? sending a sample log helps our profiling.

Attachments: perf_report_v1.pdf (initial profiling notes), MAP-Stellar-20270728.xlsx (draft mutual action plan).

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm p99 vs p95 and share a 24h sample of production logs if possible.
- Us: run focused throughput simulations against your exemplar prompt sets and return a quantified recommendation (quantization, batching, routing). ETA: 48–72 hours after we get logs.
- Sync: 30-min call next week to sign off on MAP and procurement milestones.

If that looks right, I can put time on the calendar for Thursday (28/Jul) or Monday morning next week — what works for you?

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0142

--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform.
From: Jorge Ramos <jorge.ramos@stellarretail.com>

Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: streaming latency & concurrency — decision logistics

Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

1) SLA target: for our initial GA we need p95 <= 120ms; p99 can be a softer target (we'd like p99 < 300ms but it's not blocking GA acceptance).
2) Streaming vs batch: our catalog personalization and live product assistant are streaming — account recovery and bulk content generation can be batched. So streaming endpoints = 2 (primary).
3) Logs: attaching a short sample trace (streaming-latency-sample.log) and a small histogram of client-side token emission during peak.

Also FYI on concurrency: our peak concurrent sessions are expected to hit ~42 for the first month after rollout (marketing promo), then flatten to ~28. We prefer planning for the spike with autoscaling in Dedicated if possible. 

Procurement: procurement@stellarretail.com will need an initial cost estimate and rough timeline to prepare budget sign-off. Amy — looping you to coordinate.

Happy to meet Thurs or Mon — Thurs at 10:00AM PT works for us.

Regards,
Jorge
Senior Product Manager | Stellar Retail
jorge.ramos@stellarretail.com

- Rishi: I'll own the first pass throughput/latency sim. Need the following from Jorge/Amy:
  * sample prompt set (they said they have two streaming endpoints — request the exact JSON shapes)
  * the client-side token emission histogram (they attached a small one but we need the raw CSV for accurate pacing)
  * clarification whether partial responses are acceptable for the product assistant (sounds like yes for short messages).
- Priyom: please stand up a short-lived benchmark run on a 4xA100 slot with these prompt samples once they arrive — capture p50/p95/p99 and end-to-end streaming latency (first-byte and last-byte).

I'll also add a note: if they need autoscaling for the day-0 spike (42 concurrent), Dedicated reserved + burst is likely the safest path; otherwise we can offer hosted with a capacity plan and a short SLA extension. We'll include both cost/timeline options in the MAP.

Great — thanks everyone. Quick status update and next actions after reviewing Jorge's logs and our initial probe run: 

Status (internal probe):
- First-pass sim (4xA100) with their short prompt set shows p95 streaming latency ~98–110ms for 128-token updates at sustained 800 t/s. p99 sits near 260ms under burst.
- Concurrency: a single 4xA100 slot supported ~44 concurrent streaming sessions with the current batching profile before p95 degraded past 120ms — matches their spike requirements.

Deliverables we will send by EOD Friday:
- perf_report_v1.pdf (detailed numbers and charts)
- MAP-Stellar-20270728.xlsx (costing options: Hosted vs Dedicated with burst plan)
- load script and a short runbook for their acceptance test (to be used by procurement/security).

Meeting: I have scheduled a 30-min sync for Thu, 29 Jul 2027 at 10:00AM PT (calendar invite sent) to walk through the MAP and acceptance checklist. 

If procurement needs the scoped estimate earlier, Rishi — can you and Priyom pull the Hosted vs Dedicated cost comparison and put it into the MAP tab by EOD?

Thanks — excited to move this forward.
